class.name: IfcBoundaryEdgeCondition
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Describes linearly elastic support conditions or connection conditions. Applicability: Curve supports and connections. HISTORY: New entity in IFC 2x2. IFC 2x4 change: Attributes LinearStiffnessX/Y/Z renamed to TranslationalStiffnessX/Y/Z . IFC 2x4 change: All attribute data types changed from numeric to SELECT between Boolean and numeric. Stiffnesses may now also be negative,

members.member: Translational stiffness value in x-direction of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.

Translational stiffness value in y-direction of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.

Translational stiffness value in z-direction of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.

Rotational stiffness value about the x-axis of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Its type depends on the file's schema: GDIFCEntityBase in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2, float in IFC2X3.

Rotational stiffness value about the y-axis of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Its type depends on the file's schema: GDIFCEntityBase in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2, float in IFC2X3.

Rotational stiffness value about the z-axis of the coordinate system defined by the instance which uses this resource object. Its type depends on the file's schema: GDIFCEntityBase in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2, float in IFC2X3.
Only in IFC2X3 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.
